meta.title.en: DevOps Consulting for Small Software Teams | Slick

meta.description.en: Work directly with Aleksandre Ghvineria to automate workflows, improve CI/CD, secure code and secrets, and simplify cloud infrastructure.

hero.description.en: Work directly with Aleksandre Ghvineria to automate recurring work, improve CI/CD, bring code and secrets checks into your workflow, and simplify infrastructure.

specialties.title.en: LESS FRICTION, FROM END TO END

services.description.en: Practical engineering support for the things that slow your team down. From a single workflow to the infrastructure behind it.

services.automation.description.en: Connect your tools and turn recurring tasks into dependable workflows. Less copying, clicking, and chasing things down.

services.delivery.description.en: Build pipelines your team can trust, with useful feedback, repeatable releases, and fewer manual steps between commit and deploy.

services.security.description.en: Catch vulnerable code, exposed secrets, and risky dependencies earlier. Put practical security checks where your developers already work.

services.infrastructure.description.en: Simplify your environments, find wasted resources, and move manual configuration into versioned, repeatable infrastructure as code.

approach.description.en: You work directly with me, from the first conversation to the final handover.

approach.understand.description.en: We start with your team, your setup, and what is getting in the way.

approach.plan.description.en: Agree on a practical scope, clear priorities, and what a good result looks like.

approach.build.description.en: Implement in manageable steps, with testing and visibility along the way.

approach.handover.description.en: Leave you with documented systems and the knowledge to keep them running.

toolkit.description.en: Cloud, on-prem, or somewhere in between. I work with the tools that fit your team and the systems you already have.

about.subtitle.en: An independent DevOps and automation consultant, and the person behind Slick.

about.description.en: I help small software teams make their day-to-day engineering work simpler. That might mean untangling a deployment pipeline, bringing infrastructure into code, or connecting tools so a repetitive task takes care of itself.

about.approach.en: My approach is practical: understand the problem, choose the right tools, and leave your team with something they can confidently own.

contact.description.en: Tell me about your team, your current setup, and what you want to improve. Let me know whether you are looking for a defined project or ongoing engineering support.

pipeline.label.en: An illustrative delivery pipeline: commit, check, build, deploy, and observe.

error.description.en: Let’s get you back to something useful.

hero.proof.en: Production experience across systems administration, delivery pipelines and code security.

services.automation.proof.en: Recent example: automated report generation and downloads, then parsed the data and visualized the results to make recurring reporting easier.

services.delivery.proof.en: At JSC Liberty Bank, I overhauled build, deploy, and rollback pipelines across every application — frontend and backend — including apps that had no automation at all before.

services.security.proof.en: Currently working hands-on with GitHub Advanced Security, CodeQL, and Mend.io in production at EPAM Systems.

services.infrastructure.proof.en: Managed and supported 170+ Windows and Linux virtual machines at Georgia's High Council of Justice, and run a full Proxmox/Kubernetes/Ansible homelab in my own time.

work.description.en: Employment experience working hands-on with production systems.

work.liberty.description.en: rebuilt CI/CD and rollback pipelines for every application, frontend and backend.

work.justice.org.en: High Council of Justice of Georgia

work.justice.description.en: provisioned and maintained 170+ virtual machines across Windows and Linux.

about.intro.en: I'm Aleksandre, an independent DevOps and automation consultant working under the name Slick.

about.background.en: My background spans systems administration, application server administration, and DevOps: from supporting 170+ VMs at Georgia's High Council of Justice, to overhauling CI/CD pipelines for every application at JSC Liberty Bank, to my current work in security scanning and cloud infrastructure at EPAM Systems.

about.credentials.en: I hold LPIC-1 and LPIC-2 certifications from the Linux Professional Institute, and a BSc in Electrical & Computer Engineering from the Agricultural University of Tbilisi. Outside of client work, I run a full homelab (Proxmox, Kubernetes, OPNsense) and build small tools for fun — including a remote-start system for a Gen 2/3 Toyota Prius as a university project.

contact.proof.en: You work directly with me, from the first conversation to handover.

about.card.punchline.en: Good systems start with a conversation. Tell me what’s slowing your team down, and let’s make it simpler.

hero.coverage.en: Remote support for international software teams. Scoped implementation projects and ongoing engineering support.

engagement.description.en: Remote collaboration with international software teams. Tell me about your current setup and what you want to improve.

engagement.project.description.en: Bring a pipeline, workflow or infrastructure problem. We can discuss the work needed and what a useful result looks like for your team.

engagement.support.description.en: Get help with improvements as your systems and priorities evolve. Tell me where your team needs continuing support.
